takes.h: Boss Fight Studio's Hellboy 1/12 Wave 2 up for pre-order
takes.p: Boss Fight Studio's second wave of 1/12-scale Hellboy figures comprises Hellboy (Wolves of St. August), Abe Sapien (Hollow Earth) and Koshchei the Deathless (Darkness Calls), The Toyark reports. Pre-orders are at Entertainment Earth and Big Bad Toy Store; shipping is scheduled for the third quarter of 2027.
